claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu defines a Matrix as shared ideas and rules shaped by limited biological perception; each culture may have its own.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: A physical super-Matrix contains many cultures.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says souls in astral realms view physical incarnations as simulations or learning experiences.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says this perspective contrasts with the seriousness and suffering experienced in physical life.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the lower astral is manifested by living souls' unconscious fears and collective attention.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes dark entities as egregors sustained by creative attention, especially fear.
